units.rationale: Root assigned from createApi(), which the census cannot decide; decided by reading createApi: it returns { slugify, truncate, titleCase } plus one generated converter per SEPARATORS key (kebabCase '-', snakeCase '_'), all built on the internal words() splitter. slugify/truncate/titleCase/words are carried by B-SLUGIFY/B-TRUNCATE/B-TITLECASE/B-WORDS; the generated keys by B-CASE-CONVERTERS. The ESM target exports each as a static named export.
Static top-level string assignment '2.1.0' after the root export; becomes the named export VERSION.
